exposure: Maternal 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D) concentrations at 12-15 weeks gestation
outcome: Adipokine levels (omentin-1, visfatin, high molecular weight (HMW) adiponectin)
cohort: 102 overweight or obese pregnant women at high risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Lower maternal 25(OH)D concentrations in overweight/obese pregnant women at high-risk of GDM were associated with increased cardiometabolic risks during pregnancy and adverse pregnancy outcomes, and these associations may be mediated by HMW-adiponectin.
gest_age: 12-15 weeks at baseline, followed throughout pregnancy
